elevatemindhq 18h Toe hair can be a useful circulation clue. Hair follicles need steady blood flow, so visible hair on the feet often suggests blood is reaching the skin. A sudden loss of toe hair can sometimes appear with poor circulation. It is not a perfect heart test. Cold feet, color changes, numbness, slow-healing sores, or weak pulses are stronger reasons to get circulation checked. #circulationhealth #healthtips 1K 19 26 129
